items: 4–5 lb potatoes, peeled, halved lengthwise, then sliced
Cornstarch to thicken slightly, but leave about the consistency of heavy cream

steps.title: Cook the potatoes
steps.body: Cook, then drain, being careful not to overcook to mush: **4–5 lb potatoes**, peeled, halved lengthwise, then sliced.

steps.title: Fry the bacon and onion
steps.body: In another pan, dice and fry until crisp: **⅓ pound bacon** and **1 large onion**, diced.

steps.title: Make the dressing
steps.body: Save **2–3 Tbsp bacon grease** in pan, discarding the rest. Then add to bacon pan and simmer: **3 cups water**, **1 cup sugar**, **½ cup vinegar** and cornstarch to thicken slightly, but leave about the consistency of heavy cream.

steps.title: Combine
steps.body: Pour the bacon and sauce over drained potatoes in a bowl and gently fold to coat. Salt and pepper to taste.
